display.name: Fleet Operations | FDE
display.description: Operational fleet cockpit. Activity is observed, not a liveness guarantee. Filters apply to trace panels; quota panels are fleet-wide, unverified reports. Request-level native tokens are separated from hook reports. No delivery-success or authoritative quota is inferred.

display.name: Sources
display.description: Trace sources only. Select one or multiple. Quotas remain fleet-wide.

display.name: Agent regex
display.description: .* matches all. Applies to aggregate trace panels; raw inspector uses Sources only. Quotas stay global.

display.name: Project regex
display.description: .* matches all including unattributed. Applies to aggregate trace panels; raw inspector uses Sources only. Quotas stay global.

display.name: Sessions seen · last 5m
display.description: Distinct (host, agent, session) observed within the final five minutes of the selected window. Not a count of running processes.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
WITH source AS (SELECT timestamp, trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, name, duration_nano, has_error, status_code, attributes_string, attributes_number, attributes_bool,
resources_string['service.name'] AS service,
resources_string['host.name'] AS host,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['gen_ai.agent.name'],''), resources_string['service.name']) AS agent,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['workspace.project_name'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['cwd'],''),'unattributed') AS project,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['gen_ai.conversation.id'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['conversation.id'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['thread.id'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['thread_id'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['session.id'],''),'') AS session,
attributes_string['agent.hook.event'] AS hook,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['gen_ai.tool.name'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['tool.name'],''),attributes_string['tool_name']) AS tool,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['gen_ai.request.model'],''),attributes_string['model']) AS model,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['capability.kind'],''),if(name='mcp.tools.call','mcp','unclassified')) AS capability,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['capability.namespace'],''),attributes_string['mcp.server.name']) AS namespace
FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
WHERE resource_string_service$$name IN $service_name
AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}}
AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}), fleet AS (SELECT * FROM source WHERE match(agent, $agent_filter) AND match(project, $project_filter))
SELECT now() AS ts, toFloat64(uniqExactIf(tuple(host,agent,session), session!='' AND timestamp >= {{.end_datetime}} - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)) AS value FROM fleet

display.name: Session board · latest evidence
display.description: One row per source, host, agent and session; state derives from the latest hook and is observational only. A five-minute silence marks unknown, never stopped. No heartbeat/process census. Tokens here are native request reports only. Unattributed projects remain visible.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
WITH source AS (SELECT timestamp, trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, name, duration_nano, has_error, status_code, attributes_string, attributes_number, attributes_bool,
resources_string['service.name'] AS service,
resources_string['host.name'] AS host,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['gen_ai.agent.name'],''), resources_string['service.name']) AS agent,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['workspace.project_name'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['cwd'],''),'unattributed') AS project,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['gen_ai.conversation.id'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['conversation.id'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['thread.id'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['thread_id'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['session.id'],''),'') AS session,
attributes_string['agent.hook.event'] AS hook,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['gen_ai.tool.name'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['tool.name'],''),attributes_string['tool_name']) AS tool,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['gen_ai.request.model'],''),attributes_string['model']) AS model,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['capability.kind'],''),if(name='mcp.tools.call','mcp','unclassified')) AS capability,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['capability.namespace'],''),attributes_string['mcp.server.name']) AS namespace
FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
WHERE resource_string_service$$name IN $service_name
AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}}
AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}), fleet AS (SELECT * FROM source WHERE match(agent, $agent_filter) AND match(project, $project_filter))
SELECT now() AS ts, service AS Source,host AS Host,agent AS Agent,session AS Session,
argMax(project,timestamp) AS Project,
multiIf(dateDiff('second',max(timestamp),{{.end_datetime}})>300,'Unknown / no recent signal',argMax(hook,timestamp)='PreToolUse','Tool start observed',argMax(hook,timestamp)='PreInvocation','Turn start observed',argMax(hook,timestamp)='Stop','Turn stop observed',argMax(hook,timestamp)='PostToolUse','Tool returned',argMax(hook,timestamp)='PostInvocation','Turn returned','Native activity observed') AS Evidence,
argMax(if(tool!='',tool,name),timestamp) AS Last_action,
formatDateTime(max(timestamp),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S','UTC') AS Last_seen_UTC,
toFloat64(greatest(0,dateDiff('second',max(timestamp),{{.end_datetime}}))) AS Age_seconds,
toFloat64(countIf((hook = 'PostToolUse' OR (hook = '' AND name = 'mcp.tools.call')) AND has_error)) AS Error_returns
FROM fleet WHERE session!='' GROUP BY service,host,agent,session ORDER BY Age_seconds ASC,Error_returns DESC LIMIT 50

display.name: Attention · recent failure / approval evidence
display.description: Prioritized error and approval-request evidence, not a queue of confirmed pending work. A later successful retry or approval may have resolved it. Open the matching trace in the event inspector. User interruptions are labeled by their reported category.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
WITH source AS (SELECT timestamp, trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, name, duration_nano, has_error, status_code, attributes_string, attributes_number, attributes_bool,
resources_string['service.name'] AS service,
resources_string['host.name'] AS host,

coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['workspace.project_name'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['cwd'],''),'unattributed') AS project,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['gen_ai.conversation.id'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['conversation.id'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['thread.id'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['thread_id'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['session.id'],''),'') AS session,
attributes_string['agent.hook.event'] AS hook,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['gen_ai.tool.name'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['tool.name'],''),attributes_string['tool_name']) AS tool,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['gen_ai.request.model'],''),attributes_string['model']) AS model,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['capability.kind'],''),if(name='mcp.tools.call','mcp','unclassified')) AS capability,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['capability.namespace'],''),attributes_string['mcp.server.name']) AS namespace
FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
WHERE resource_string_service$$name IN $service_name
AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}}
AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}), fleet AS (SELECT * FROM source WHERE match(agent, $agent_filter) AND match(project, $project_filter))
SELECT now() AS ts, service AS Source, agent AS Agent,project AS Project,session AS Session,
if(attributes_string['agent.decision']='ask','Approval requested',if(attributes_string['agent.error.category']!='',attributes_string['agent.error.category'],'Error marked')) AS Evidence,
if(tool!='',tool,name) AS Action,
formatDateTime(timestamp,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S','UTC') AS Observed_UTC,

trace_id AS Trace
FROM fleet WHERE (((hook = 'PostToolUse' OR (hook = '' AND name = 'mcp.tools.call'))) AND has_error) OR attributes_string['agent.decision']='ask'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 20

display.name: Native request tokens / minute
display.description: One-minute buckets of native Codex handle_responses input and output tokens, deduplicated by span ID. Cache is included in input; turn summaries are excluded. Empty intervals are not filled with zero.

spec.name: A

resources_string['service.name'] AS service,

attributes_string['agent.hook.event'] AS hook,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['gen_ai.tool.name'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['tool.name'],''),attributes_string['tool_name']) AS tool,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['gen_ai.request.model'],''),attributes_string['model']) AS model,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['capability.kind'],''),if(name='mcp.tools.call','mcp','unclassified')) AS capability,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['capability.namespace'],''),attributes_string['mcp.server.name']) AS namespace
FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
WHERE resource_string_service$$name IN $service_name
AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}}
AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}), fleet AS (SELECT * FROM source WHERE match(agent, $agent_filter) AND match(project, $project_filter))
SELECT toStartOfMinute(observed) AS ts,token_type,toFloat64(sum(tokens)) AS value FROM (
SELECT trace_id,span_id,max(timestamp) AS observed,'input' AS token_type,max(attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']) AS tokens FROM fleet WHERE (name='handle_responses' AND hook='' AND mapContains(attributes_number,'gen_ai.usage.input_tokens')) GROUP BY trace_id,span_id
UNION ALL SELECT trace_id,span_id,max(timestamp) AS observed,'output' AS token_type,max(attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) AS tokens FROM fleet WHERE (name='handle_responses' AND hook='' AND mapContains(attributes_number,'gen_ai.usage.input_tokens')) GROUP BY trace_id,span_id)
GROUP BY ts,token_type ORDER BY ts ASC

display.name: Native tokens · model / source
display.description: Request-level input, output and cache subset. Never add cached tokens to input again. Source-specific native token coverage; does not estimate subscription quota or monetary cost.

spec.name: A

coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['gen_ai.tool.name'],''),nullIf(attributes_string['tool.name'],''),attributes_string['tool_name']) AS tool,
coalesce(nullIf(attributes_string['gen_ai.request.model'],''),attributes_string['model']) AS model,

AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}}
AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}), fleet AS (SELECT * FROM source WHERE match(agent, $agent_filter) AND match(project, $project_filter))
SELECT now() AS ts,service AS Source,model AS Model,toFloat64(count()) AS Requests,sum(input) AS Input,sum(output) AS Output,sum(cache) AS Cached_input
FROM (SELECT service,model,trace_id,span_id,max(attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']) AS input,max(attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) AS output,max(greatest(attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'],attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.cache_read_tokens'])) AS cache FROM fleet WHERE (name='handle_responses' AND hook='' AND mapContains(attributes_number,'gen_ai.usage.input_tokens')) GROUP BY service,model,trace_id,span_id) GROUP BY service,model ORDER BY Input DESC LIMIT 20

display.description: Only sources observed in the selected time window; no installed-agent inventory. Age is measured at window end. Token fields are reported records, not total consumption. Missing project/session attribution is visible.

spec.query:

SELECT now() AS ts,service AS Source,host AS Host,
toFloat64(count()) AS Spans,
toFloat64(greatest(0,dateDiff('second',max(timestamp),{{.end_datetime}}))) AS Age_seconds,
